title: wt refs sweep --yes --json
description: What `wt refs sweep --yes` moved. Printed by `wt refs sweep --yes --json` as the only thing on stdout, also when a handled SIGINT or SIGTERM ends the run. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

token.description: The token of the plan the run went by.

runId.description: The run's id, which names its pins; null when nothing was to be moved or the run was refused.

outcome.description: done: every selected row was swept. refused: nothing was pinned or deleted (error says why, e.g. --expect). partial: some were, some not. interrupted: a signal ended the run.

code.description: remoteAmbiguous: --remote, and origin's effective fetch and push URLs are not one and the same URL. remoteCredentialsInUrl: --remote, and that URL carries a password (in any form, scp-like too), or any userinfo on http, https, ftp or ftps; a <transport>::<address> URL is judged on its address too. planChanged: the plan is not the one --expect named, or not the one the question was asked about. runIdTaken: --run-id names a run that has refs under refs/wt-swept/ already.

problems.description: Codes for why the run refused; empty otherwise.

id.description: refs/heads/<name> or refs/tags/<name> here; origin:refs/heads/<name> or origin:refs/tags/<name> on origin. --only takes it, one id per flag and never split: a ref name may contain a comma.

category.description: backupContained: another ref contains it (selected). backupOld: it holds commits no other ref has and is older than age (selected). backupYoung: the same, younger (not selected unless --only names it). kept: something holds it; kept says what.

result.description: swept: pinned and deleted. kept: the plan kept it, or it moved or was taken after the plan (reason says). failed: tried and not finished (pinned and deleted say what did happen). notRun: the run ended before it. interrupted: a signal caught it. notSelected: the plan did not select it.

pin.description: refs/wt-swept/<runId>/{heads,tags,remote-heads,remote-tags}/<name>, for a selected row once the run began.

pinned.description: The pin holds object, read back after the row.

deleted.description: The ref is gone, here or on origin, read back after the row.

restoreCommand.description: For a row pinned and deleted: the argv that puts it back.
